talentIII.name: Unclaimed Victory
talentIII.description: When Kiva defeats a Forsaken target, she gains a Shield equal to 12% of her Max HP for 2 rounds, and 12% more for each Broken Link she is holding, up to 36%. All Broken Links are consumed. Measured: every payout in every harness arena is 12%, because Abandoned Support banks at most one Broken Link a round and Severance Paid spends it on the next basic against a Forsaken body, so a kill finds none held. The two link-gated clauses are authored and inert at those rates.

passive2.name: Volume Closed
passive2.description: When a Footnote record reaches its cap, the target cannot gain buffs for 1 round, loses turn progress, has Footnote removed and takes damage equal to the whole record, and Seraphine gains 15 Energy. Pinoy writes it in two beats, with the removal and the Energy arriving when the restriction ends, and says nothing about the record being paid out. Both departures are the same repair: the second beat was gated on a Mark that Contrary Evidence - Seraphine's own Dispel - strips on the same trigger that fills the record, so it could never run, and a record that reached its cap was thrown away unread. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/PINOY-LIST.md section 2d.

basic.name: Faultline Tap
basic.description: Deals 155% Attack damage and applies Cracked for 2 rounds. Cracked reduces Block by 18%.

active.name: Demolition Right
active.description: Deals 340% Attack damage to the front enemy. If it is Cracked, removes Cracked and grants Branik a Shield equal to 34% Max HP for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Salvaged Cover
passive1.description: The first time each round a Cracked enemy attacks, Branik gains 12% Damage Reduction until round end.

basic.name: Notice of Loss
basic.description: Deals 180% Attack damage and applies Arrears for 2 rounds. At turn end, Arrears loses 4% of its current HP, bounded at 105% of Demos's Attack. The bound is not in Pinoy's sentence and is the only thing holding the clause inside the star band; it is enforced on the Notice of Loss tick passive - see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 12.

active.name: Compounding Sentence
active.description: Deals 360% Attack damage to enemies with Arrears and extends Arrears by 1 round, up to 3 rounds.

passive1.name: No Appeal
passive1.description: Enemies with Arrears receive 30% less healing; on defeat, their Arrears moves to the highest-HP enemy.

passives.name: Notice of Loss
passives.description: The Arrears tick: a body carrying it loses 4% of its current HP as its own turn ends, bounded at 105% of Demos's Attack. The bound is not in Pinoy's sentence and is the only thing holding the clause inside the band - see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 12.

basic.name: Commitment Cut
basic.description: Deals 120% Attack damage. If Kest attacked this target last turn, deals 35% additional Attack damage.

active.name: No Way Back
active.description: Deals 260% Attack damage to Kest’s last target. On defeat, attacks the lowest-HP enemy for 100% Attack damage.

passive1.name: Commit to the Return
passive1.description: Kest cannot change targets while his target lives, but deals 12% more damage to it and takes 10% less from it.

passives.name: No Way Back
passives.description: The follow-through on No Way Back only: an enemy defeated during that cast carries into the lowest-HP enemy.

basic.name: Measured Tap
basic.description: Deals 140% Attack damage and heals the lowest-HP ally for 90% Attack.

active.name: Hard Remedy
active.description: Deals 240% Attack damage to all enemies, removes one debuff from each ally, and cleansed allies recover 15% missing HP.

passive1.name: Triage After Loss
passive1.description: The first time an ally falls below 35% HP, grant them a 22% Max HP Shield for 2 rounds.

basic.name: Rangefinder Bolt
basic.description: Deals 175% Attack damage to the highest-Attack enemy and applies Exposed Frequency for 2 rounds. Allied attacks ignore 14% Defense against it.

active.name: Cut the Wire
active.description: Deals 370% Attack damage to an enemy with Exposed Frequency, then transfers its buffs to the lowest-HP enemy for 1 round.

passive1.name: Dead Channel
passive1.description: When an enemy with Exposed Frequency gains a buff, Tavia deals 85% Attack damage to it once per round.

basic.name: Mapcase Bash
basic.description: Deals 255% Attack damage and applies Lost Route for 2 rounds. Lost Route reduces Accuracy by 12%.

active.name: Erase the Road
active.description: Deals 400% Attack damage to all enemies with Lost Route and grants Adric a Shield equal to 12% Max HP for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: No Return Mark
passive1.description: When an attack from an enemy carrying Lost Route misses Adric, he gains 8 Energy. Pinoy writes it as any miss by a Lost Route enemy; the engine raises its miss window on the body that dodged, so only Adric dodging reaches him. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 24.

basic.name: Scoring Point
basic.description: Deals 350% Attack damage to the highest-Attack enemy and applies Fracture for 2 rounds. A Fractured body takes 15% more damage. Pinoy writes the bonus onto the next critical hit only; the engine has no crit-scoped damage modifier and no per-hit charge on one, so it answers every blow for the duration. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 23.

active.name: Shatterproof
active.description: Deals 540% Attack damage to an enemy with Fracture and spreads Fracture to the enemies beside it for 1 round.

passive1.name: Stress Line
passive1.description: When an enemy with Fracture is defeated, all remaining enemies lose 6 Energy.

basic.name: Stamped Parcel
basic.description: Deals 258% Attack damage and applies Delivered for 2 rounds. Delivered targets take 8% more damage from active skills. Pinoy writes it as the next active skill only; the engine has no per-hit charge on a damage modifier, so it holds for the duration. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 23.

active.name: Return to Sender
active.description: Deals 454% Attack damage to all Delivered enemies and takes Delivered back off them, giving Quin 12 Energy. Pinoy pays the 12 per target; nothing in the engine scales an amount by how many bodies an effect reached, so it pays once. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 25.

passive1.name: Urgent Matter
passive1.description: Quin opens the battle with 15 Energy already banked. Pinoy writes it as his first active skill costing 15 less; an ability cost can only be moved by a talent override, which a 3-star does not carry. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 26.

basic.name: Filed Objection
basic.description: Deals 190% Attack damage and applies Overdue for 2 rounds. Overdue reduces received healing by 15%.

active.name: Deadline
active.description: Deals 360% Attack damage to an Overdue enemy. If it is below 35% HP, deals 103% additional Attack damage.

passive1.name: No Extension
passive1.description: At round start Overdue is written back onto the enemy carrying it, so it cannot be shaken off. Pinoy writes it as Overdue being uncleansable during the round it was applied; the engine has no cleanse immunity, and a renewal is the nearest thing it can say. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 27.

basic.name: Chisel Strike
basic.description: Deals 402% Attack damage to the front enemy, and 70% more if that enemy's Shield is still standing.

passive1.name: Rubble Resolve
passive1.description: When Arno strikes an enemy carrying a Shield, he gains 8% Attack for 2 rounds. Pinoy writes it as the moment an enemy Shield is removed; a break is raised on the body that lost the Shield and on that body's own side, so the unit that broke it never hears about it. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 32.

basic.name: Splintering Blow
basic.description: Deals 323% Attack damage to the front enemy and gives Barr 8% Damage Reduction for 1 round.

passive1.name: Give Way
passive1.description: The first time Barr falls below 40% HP, he gains a Shield equal to 10% of his Max HP for 2 rounds.

basic.name: Price Breaker
basic.description: Deals 335% Attack damage to the front enemy and takes 5 Energy off it.

passive1.name: Cheap Kindling
passive1.description: When Piri defeats an enemy, the ally with the emptiest bar gains 15 Energy. Pinoy pays the 15 to Piri; a 2-star has no active skill to spend Energy on, so the spark is passed to somebody who does. See Docs/PINOY-LIST.md section 2c.

basic.name: Cargo Spark
basic.description: Deals 286% Attack damage to the enemy with the lowest HP.

basic.name: Signpost Strike
basic.description: Deals 377% Attack damage to the front enemy.

basic.name: Offered Strike
basic.description: Deals 150% Attack damage and gives the lowest-Energy ally 22 Energy.

active.name: Distribution
active.description: Deals 245% Attack damage to all enemies, then transfers the largest ally Shield to the lowest-HP ally and extends it 1 round.

passive1.name: Nothing Hoarded
passive1.description: At round start, Celen transfers 18 Energy from the highest-Energy ally to the lowest.

basic.name: Reclaimed Round
basic.description: Deals 165% Attack damage and applies Loose Parts for 2 rounds. The next ally to hit it gains 14 Energy.

active.name: Parts Exchange
active.description: Deals 295% Attack damage to enemies with Loose Parts, then moves Loose Parts to the highest-HP enemy for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Find a Use
passive1.description: When an ally gains Energy from Loose Parts, Mika gains a Shield equal to 45% Attack for 1 round.

passives.name: Reclaimed Round
passives.description: The Loose Parts payout itself: the first ally each round to strike a marked enemy takes 14 Energy off it.

basic.name: Crossing Cut
basic.description: Deals 145% Attack damage and gives the lowest-HP ally 20% of the HP they are missing, out of Rhys's own, if they are below 50% HP.

active.name: Change Sides
active.description: Deals 270% Attack damage and swaps Rhys’s buffs with the target’s debuffs for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Shared Peril
passive1.description: When an ally takes a hit exceeding 25% Max HP, Rhys takes 30% of it instead, once per round.

basic.name: Bad Omen
basic.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and changes one buff on the target into its matching debuff for 2 rounds.

active.name: Forecast Reversed
active.description: Deals 190% Attack damage to all enemies and reverses one Attack, Defense or Speed modifier on each.

passive1.name: Prediction Cost
passive1.description: Whenever Siofra changes a buff into a debuff, that target loses 10 Energy, once per round.

passives.name: Prediction Cost
passives.description: The same cost after Forecast Reversed: every enemy whose modifier was turned over loses 10 Energy.

basic.name: Wrong Turn
basic.description: Deals 290% Attack damage and applies Misdirected for 2 rounds. The first buff a Misdirected enemy gains each round goes to one of Vanno’s allies instead.

active.name: Road Not Taken
active.description: Deals 360% Attack damage to a Misdirected enemy and moves its debuffs to the highest-HP enemy for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Exit Unmarked
passive1.description: When a Misdirected enemy falls, Vanno cannot be targeted until his next turn.

passives.name: Wrong Turn
passives.description: The misdirection itself: a buff landing on a Misdirected enemy is taken off it and given to a random ally of Vanno’s, once per round.

basic.name: Shared Passage
basic.description: Deals 232% Attack damage and gives the lowest-HP ally 8% Damage Reduction for 1 round.

active.name: Take Another Route
active.description: Deals 380% Attack damage to the highest-HP enemy. Pinoy swaps the target’s present HP percentage with that body’s; the engine has no two-way exchange and no one-way transfer between two units that are not the caster, so the blow is routed to the big body instead. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 11.

passive1.name: Reserved Passage
passive1.description: The first time an ally falls below 30% HP, Bren advances their turn by 15% turn progress.

basic.name: Ricochet Mark
basic.description: Deals 251% Attack damage to the highest-Attack enemy and applies Offset for 2 rounds, then a 57% Attack ricochet strikes that enemy again and the enemies beside it. Pinoy hangs the ricochet on the next ALLY attack against an Offset body; that shape needs a link and a second passive, which a 3-star does not carry, so Cal’s own shot carries it. Draft, Pinoy to confirm.

active.name: Corner Shot
active.description: Deals 457% Attack damage to an Offset enemy, and the same blow strikes both enemies beside it.

passive1.name: New Sightline
passive1.description: When Cal defeats an Offset enemy, his next attack is a guaranteed Critical Hit. Pinoy names the splash as the killer; the engine does not record which effect of a cast landed the blow. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 28.

basic.name: Wrong Number
basic.description: Deals 215% Attack damage and applies Crossed Line for 2 rounds.

active.name: Operator Error
active.description: Deals 349% Attack damage to all Crossed Line enemies and delays each by 15% turn progress.

passive1.description: At round start, one debuff on the Crossed Line enemy is reconnected to a random enemy for 2 rounds and Linnet gains 10 Energy. Pinoy has Crossed Line reroute the first debuff to LAND on that body each round; the engine has no window for a debuff arriving on an enemy, so the reroute is done at round start on whatever is already there, and the 10 Energy pays whether or not anything moved. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md groups 29 and 30.

active.name: Reposition the Hurt

passive1.description: After Reposition the Hurt, every ally gains 8% Defense for 2 rounds. Pinoy pays only the allies who actually lost a debuff to Oswin; the engine records a removal for a cleanse, a dispel and a named strip but not for a move, so the condition that would ask has nothing to read. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 30.

basic.name: Unmoored Swing
basic.description: Deals 370% Attack damage to the front enemy and advances Dett's next turn by 8%.

passive1.name: Turn With It
passive1.description: When an active skill is aimed at Dett, he gains 8% Damage Reduction for 1 round.

basic.name: Cargo Bolt
basic.description: Deals 329% Attack damage to the front enemy, takes 5 Energy off it and gives 5 Energy to the ally with the emptiest bar.

passive1.name: Counterweight
passive1.description: An ally Hod hands Energy to gains 5% Defense for 1 round.

basic.name: Deflection Shot
basic.description: Deals 385% Attack damage to the front enemy and gives the lowest-HP ally 5% Speed for 1 round.

passive1.name: Second Bearing
passive1.description: Yara never aims twice running at the same enemy, and gains 10% Attack for 1 round each time she takes a new bearing. Pinoy writes it as a reward for changing target and pays it in Energy; nothing lets a hero hear its own target change, and a 2-star has no active skill to spend Energy on, so the switch is made a standing rule and the reward is paid in Attack. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 33.

basic.name: Side Shot
basic.description: Deals 298% Attack damage to a random enemy.

basic.name: Wheelhouse Swing
basic.description: Deals 348% Attack damage to the front enemy and gives 5 Energy to the ally with the emptiest bar. Pinoy pays the 5 to Orenna; a 1-star has no active skill to spend Energy on, so the wheel passes it on. See Docs/PINOY-LIST.md section 2c.

basic.name: Measurement Strike
basic.description: Deals 210% Attack damage and applies Settling for 2 rounds. Settling reduces Speed by 8% each round, up to 24%.

active.name: Weight of Time
active.description: Deals 400% Attack damage to enemies with Settling. Targets at 24% Speed Down are Stunned for 1 round.

passive1.name: Load Bearing
passive1.description: When Settling expires, apply 15% Defense Down for 2 rounds.

basic.name: Reserve Swing
basic.description: Deals 60% Attack damage and grants Reserve for 2 rounds. Reserve reduces the next damage taken by 18%.

active.name: Open the Reserve
active.description: Deals 90% Attack damage to all enemies and grants Reserve to all allies for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Rationed Strength
passive1.description: When Reserve prevents damage, its holder recovers 4% Max HP, or gains 6 Energy if it is already whole.

basic.name: Holdfast Thrust
basic.description: Deals 145% Attack damage. If Jory was attacked since his last turn, he heals 4% Max HP.

active.name: Bar the Way
active.description: Deals 230% Attack damage and Taunts the front enemy for 2 rounds; it deals 15% less damage to Jory.

passive1.name: Worn Hinges
passive1.description: The first time each round an enemy hits Jory, he counterattacks it for 110% Attack damage.

basic.name: Returning Shot
basic.description: Deals 280% Attack damage; if the target attacked an ally since Maera's last turn, deals 70% additional Attack damage.

active.name: Keep the Beacon
active.description: Deals 540% Attack damage to the enemy that most recently damaged an ally. On defeat, allies recover 7% Max HP.

passive1.name: Watch the Water
passive1.description: The first time each ally falls below 45% HP, Maera’s next attack is a guaranteed Critical.

passives.name: Keep the Beacon
passives.description: The relief on Keep the Beacon only: an enemy defeated during that cast sends every ally 7% of their Max HP.

basic.name: Waking Touch
basic.description: Deals 130% Attack damage and heals the lowest-HP ally for 60% Attack.

active.name: Unfinished Rest
active.description: Deals 210% Attack damage to all enemies and gives the two lowest-HP allies Recovery for 3 rounds. Recovery heals 3% Max HP each turn.

passive1.name: Do Not Disturb
passive1.description: When an ally with Recovery would die, remove Recovery and leave them at 1 HP. Once per battle.

basic.name: Recorded Shot
basic.description: Deals 330% Attack damage and applies Accounted for 2 rounds. Pinoy also has attacks against an Accounted body unable to miss; nothing in the engine negates a miss chance, so that half is carried in the text only. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 31.

active.name: Evidence Kept
active.description: Deals 480% Attack damage to an Accounted enemy and heals the lowest-HP ally for 6% Max HP.

passive1.name: Nothing Forgotten
passive1.description: When an Accounted enemy is defeated, Brio writes Accounted onto the highest-HP enemy for 2 rounds.

basic.name: Mending Prick
basic.description: Deals 179% Attack damage and heals the lowest-HP ally for 89% Attack.

active.name: Hold the Seam
active.description: Deals 268% Attack damage to all enemies and gives the lowest-HP ally Stitching for 3 rounds. Stitching heals 3% of its holder's Max HP at turn end.

passive1.name: Tighten the Thread
passive1.description: When Stitching runs its course, its holder gains 10 Energy.

basic.name: Garrison Guard
basic.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and gives the lowest-HP ally Coverguard for 2 rounds. Coverguard reduces the next hit by 14%.

active.name: Reserve Shelter
active.description: Deals 165% Attack damage to all enemies and gives every ally Coverguard for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Relief After Loss
passive1.description: When Coverguard is consumed, its holder heals 3% Max HP.

basic.name: Patch Round
basic.description: Deals 141% Attack damage and gives a random ally Patchwork for 2 rounds. Patchwork grants 8% Defense.

active.name: Keep It Running
active.description: Deals 235% Attack damage to all enemies and puts every Patchwork back to its full 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Borrowed Time
passive1.description: When a blow would kill an ally carrying Patchwork, Patchwork goes instead and the ally is left at 1 HP. Once per battle.

basic.name: Frame Strike
basic.description: Deals 356% Attack damage to the front enemy and gives Garron 6% Block for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Set Iron
passive1.description: When Garron blocks an attack, he heals 3% of his Max HP.

basic.name: Roadside Care
basic.description: Deals 422% Attack damage to the front enemy and heals the lowest-HP ally for 190% of Attack.

passive1.name: Carry On
passive1.description: An ally who is still below 35% HP after being healed gains 6% Damage Reduction for 1 round. Pinoy writes it as the first time only; a once-per-battle limit is spent when the trigger arrives rather than when the clause lands, so it would be gone on the battle's first heal whatever that ally's health. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 34.

basic.name: Mended Shot
basic.description: Deals 331% Attack damage to the front enemy and gives a random ally 5% Defense for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Useful Again
passive1.description: When an ally carrying Wynn's Defense buff is hit, that ally gains 5 Energy. Pinoy pays the 5 to Wynn; a 2-star has no active skill to spend Energy on, so the hand-me-down keeps paying its holder. See Docs/PINOY-LIST.md section 2c.

basic.name: Cache Shovel
basic.description: Deals 376% Attack damage to the front enemy and recovers 2% of Hal's Max HP.

basic.name: Tokenkeeper's Tap
basic.description: Deals 437% Attack damage to the front enemy and heals the lowest-HP ally for 131% of Attack.

basic.name: Offbeat Chime
basic.description: Deals 105% of Attack damage to the enemy with the highest Energy and reduces that enemy's Energy by 10. If the target has more Energy than Dahlia, the lowest-HP ally is healed for 45% of Attack.

active.name: Scattered Choir
active.description: Deals 165% of Attack damage to all enemies and creates a Displaced state on the enemy with the highest Energy for 2 rounds. Displaced enemies cannot target the same ally twice in a row. Whenever a Displaced enemy attacks an ally, that ally gains 10 Energy and Dahlia heals them for 70% of Attack. If the Displaced enemy uses an Active Skill while Displaced, cancel the skill and remove Displaced.

talentI.name: Restless Chorus
talentI.description: Displaced lasts 1 additional round. The first time a Displaced enemy changes its attack target each round, that enemy also loses 10 Energy.

talentII.name: Shared Rhythm
talentII.description: Whenever Dahlia heals an ally through Broken Rhythm, the ally with the second-lowest HP is also healed for 40% of Attack.

talentIII.name: Final Cadence
talentIII.description: When Displaced ends without the enemy having its Active Skill canceled, Dahlia deals 120% of Attack damage to that enemy and immediately restores 20 Energy to the ally with the lowest Energy.

basic.name: Shove Aside
basic.description: Deals 150% Attack damage and shoves the target out of position if another enemy is alive.

active.name: Redeploy Cover
active.description: Deals 250% Attack damage to all enemies and grants Mobile Cover for 2 rounds; it reduces the first area hit each round by 20%.

passive1.name: Leave No Corner
passive1.description: When an ally with Mobile Cover is singled out, its turn progress advances by 12%.

basic.name: Ringing Slug
basic.description: Deals 230% Attack damage and applies Ringing for 2 rounds. A Ringing enemy loses 5 Energy whenever it casts an active skill.

active.name: No Quiet Moment
active.description: Deals 400% Attack damage to enemies with Ringing, cancels a cast in flight and takes 20 Energy off every Ringing enemy.

passive1.name: Aftershock Clock
passive1.description: At round end, Ringing enemies are delayed by 15% turn progress.

passives.name: Ringing Slug
passives.description: The toll itself: a Ringing enemy loses 5 Energy as it casts.

basic.name: Bad Entrance
basic.description: Deals 175% Attack damage and applies Flustered for 2 rounds, reducing Effect Hit by 15%.

active.name: Take the Floor
active.description: Deals 320% Attack damage to a Flustered enemy and forces its next attack onto Niko.

passive1.name: Ruin the Agenda
passive1.description: When a Flustered enemy attempts a debuff, Flustered is replaced by Silence for 1 round. Silence prevents active skills.

basic.name: Cut In
basic.description: Deals 130% Attack damage and advances Sable’s next turn by 10%. If Never Waiting is banked, deals 30% additional Attack damage and spends it.

active.name: Wrong Order
active.description: Deals 215% Attack damage to all enemies and delays the highest-Energy enemy by 25% turn progress.

passive1.name: Never Waiting
passive1.description: Whenever Sable delays an enemy, she gains 12 Energy and banks 30% Attack damage onto her next Basic Attack.

basic.name: Snag
basic.description: Deals 135% Attack damage and removes 6% turn progress for each target buff, up to 18%.

active.name: Pull the Seam
active.description: Deals 215% Attack damage to all enemies. Targets above 50% turn progress are delayed 20% and take 15% more Skill Damage for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Unraveling Order
passive1.description: The first enemy delayed each round gains 10% Defense Down for 2 rounds.

basic.name: Offbeat Note
basic.description: Deals 380% Attack damage and applies Disrupted for 2 rounds. A Disrupted enemy loses 8 Energy the first time each round it would gain any. Pinoy has the toll land after the enemy casts an active skill; the engine's Disrupted intercepts an Energy gain instead, and the shape that answers a cast needs a second passive a 3-star does not carry. Draft, Pinoy to confirm.

active.name: Break the Measure
active.description: Deals 520% Attack damage to all Disrupted enemies and delays each by 15% turn progress. Pinoy gives the delay a 50% chance; EffectDef.Chance is read at the ApplyStatus landing roll and nowhere else, so the delay is certain. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 15.

passive1.name: Encore Denied
passive1.description: The first enemy delayed each round takes 10% more damage until its next turn.

basic.name: Platform Change
basic.description: Deals 110% Attack damage and advances Lydia's next turn by 8% turn progress.

active.name: Miss the Train
active.description: Deals 180% Attack damage to all enemies and delays the slowest enemy by 30% turn progress.

passive1.name: No Fixed Departure
passive1.description: At the start of each of her turns Lydia gains 10% Damage Reduction until her next turn. Pinoy gates it on her acting before the slowest enemy; a condition can compare the caster against the body an effect LANDS on and against nobody else, and this one lands on Lydia. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 6.

basic.name: Unexpected Entry
basic.description: Deals 256% Attack damage and applies Off Balance for 2 rounds. Off Balance lowers Effect Resist by 15%.

active.name: Through the Service Door
active.description: Deals 360% Attack damage to an Off Balance enemy and takes one buff off it.

passive1.name: Leave Before Asked
passive1.description: After Roan defeats an Off Balance enemy, Roan cannot be targeted until his next turn.

basic.name: Prybar
basic.description: Deals 260% Attack damage and takes 10% turn progress off the target.

active.name: Force the Exit
active.description: Deals 409% Attack damage to the front enemy and Taunts it for 1 round; it loses 15% Speed for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Keep Moving
passive1.description: When a slowed enemy hits Tomas, he gains a Shield worth 10% of his Max HP for 1 round.

basic.name: Rattle Shot
basic.description: Deals 322% Attack damage to the front enemy and puts its turn back by 8%.

passive1.name: Loose Spring
passive1.description: When Jax puts an enemy's turn back, he gains 5% Speed for 1 round.

basic.name: Skip Ahead
basic.description: Deals 384% Attack damage to the front enemy and advances Kora's next turn by 10%.

passive1.name: First Opening
passive1.description: Kora's strike deals 38% of Attack in additional damage to an enemy that has not acted this round. Pinoy writes it as 10% more damage; the engine's damage modifiers are counted off a status the target carries, and there is none that reads a condition, so the tenth is authored as a second blow. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 35.

basic.name: Displaced Arrow
basic.description: Deals 374% Attack damage to the front enemy and applies 8% Speed Down for 1 round.

passive1.name: Unfixed Aim
passive1.description: Sena's shot bites 85% of Attack deeper into a slowed enemy. Pinoy writes it as 10% Critical Chance against the slowed; StatusKind has no Critical Chance entry, so the advantage is paid as damage instead. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 13.

basic.name: Latchbreaker
basic.description: Deals 345% Attack damage to the front enemy and gives Bex 5% Speed for 1 round.

basic.name: Rolling Shot
basic.description: Deals 415% Attack damage to the front enemy and puts its turn back by 5%.

basic.name: Strike the Line
basic.description: Deals 160% Attack damage, removes one buff from the target and applies 10% Effect Hit Down for 2 rounds.

active.name: Record Withheld
active.description: Deals 260% Attack damage to all enemies and applies Unlisted for 1 round. An Unlisted enemy loses 8 Energy instead of gaining it, once that round.

passive1.name: Missing Precedent
passive1.description: When an Unlisted enemy finishes casting an active skill, one of its buffs is struck from the record.

basic.name: Decoy Round
basic.description: Deals 120% Attack damage and applies False Lead for 2 rounds. The next single target skill aimed at Ruma lands on one of that enemy’s own allies instead, for 20% less damage.

active.name: Everyone Looks Here
active.description: Deals 170% Attack damage to all enemies and grants Ruma Concealed for 1 round. A Concealed unit cannot be targeted directly.

passive1.name: Spare Route
passive1.description: Whenever False Lead sends a blow somewhere else, Ruma gains 15 Energy.

basic.name: Lockstep
basic.description: Deals 240% Attack damage and applies Sealed for 2 rounds. A Sealed target cannot receive new buffs.

active.name: No Entry
active.description: Deals 410% Attack damage and Taunts the front enemy for 2 rounds. While Taunted it is Sealed.

passive1.name: Unasked Question
passive1.description: The first time each round a Sealed enemy strikes another ally, Toren gains a 15% Max HP Shield and redirects 25% of that hit.

basic.name: Returned Mail
basic.description: Deals 251% Attack damage and applies Withheld for 2 rounds. A Withheld body cannot gain new buffs.

active.name: Keep the Secret
active.description: Deals 406% Attack damage to the front enemy and Taunts it for 1 round; it is also Withheld for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Private Address
passive1.description: When a Withheld enemy strikes an ally, Petra gains 8% Damage Reduction for 1 round. Pinoy writes it on the enemy TARGETING an ally; the window the engine opens is the blow landing, so a strike that misses or is blocked does not reach it. Draft, Pinoy to confirm.

active.name: Immaculate Record
active.description: Deals 185% Attack damage to all enemies and marks the enemy with the highest Attack as the Subject for 3 rounds. The first time the Subject takes damage from Altheon each round, record 30% of that damage, up to 50% of Altheon's Attack. When the Subject expires it takes damage equal to the whole record. Pinoy writes the Subject as 2 rounds and the ceiling as 120% of Attack; at those numbers the ceiling needs a single blow of four times Altheon's Attack and the Subject outruns him, so the record got one blow a round and never closed. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/PINOY-LIST.md section 2d.

basic.name: Catalogue Shot
basic.description: Deals 270% Attack damage and assigns Case Number for 2 rounds, listing the target for the whole line.

active.name: Close the Case
active.description: Deals 490% Attack damage to an enemy with Case Number. Damage increases 10% per displayed buff, up to 40%.

passive1.name: No Unfiled Death
passive1.description: When an enemy with Case Number falls, every ally gains 8 Energy and the highest-Attack enemy is listed in its place.

basic.name: Tested Touch
basic.description: Deals 130% Attack damage and removes one debuff from the lowest-HP ally.

active.name: Name the Wound
active.description: Deals 230% Attack damage to all enemies and grants Diagnosed for 2 rounds. Diagnosed allies receive 18% more healing.

passive1.name: Exact Treatment
passive1.description: When Lio removes a debuff, that ally recovers 5% of the HP it is missing and gains 10 Energy.

basic.name: Stamp of Entry
basic.description: Deals 310% Attack damage and applies Registered for 2 rounds.

active.name: Hold the Line
active.description: Deals 520% Attack damage and holds the target in place for 2 rounds, during which it takes 12% more damage from Nadine.

passive1.name: Proper Place
passive1.description: The first time each round a Registered enemy hides itself, Nadine strikes it for 110% Attack damage and strips the concealment.

basic.name: Case Note
basic.description: Deals 243% Attack damage and removes one debuff from the lowest-HP ally.

active.name: Prescribe Exactly
active.description: Deals 364% Attack damage to all enemies and gives all allies Clarified for 2 rounds. Clarified allies gain 12% Effect Resist.

passive1.name: Known Condition
passive1.description: When Clara takes a debuff off an ally, that ally gains 12 Energy. Pinoy pays only for a CONTROL debuff; no field and no condition carries the kind a removal took, so every debuff pays. Draft, Pinoy to confirm, see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 18.
